items.informal_name: Cardinality Product Identity for Finite Types
items.type:
∀ (α : Type u_4) (β : Type u_5) [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β],
  Fintype.card (α × β) = Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β
items.informal_description: For finite types $\alpha$ and $\beta$, the cardinality of their Cartesian product $\alpha \times \beta$ is equal to the product of their cardinalities, i.e., $\#(\alpha \times \beta) = \#\alpha \times \#\beta$.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Dependent Product of Finite Sets: $ |s.\pi t| = \prod_{i \in s} |t(i)| $
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (t : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)),
  (s.pi t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ over a type $ \iota $ and a function $ t $ assigning to each $ i \in s $ a finite set $ t(i) $, the cardinality of the set of all functions $ f $ such that $ f(i) \in t(i) $ for each $ i \in s $ is equal to the product of the cardinalities of each $ t(i) $, i.e., $ |s.\pi t| = \prod_{i \in s} |t(i)| $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Product Set Equals Product of Cardinalities
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [h : Fintype α] {ι : α → Type u_3} {s : (i : α) → Set (ι i)},
  (Set.univ.pi s).encard = ∏ i, (s i).encard
items.informal_description: For a finite type $\alpha$ and a family of sets $s_i$ indexed by $\alpha$, the extended cardinality of the Cartesian product $\prod_{i \in \alpha} s_i$ is equal to the product of the extended cardinalities of each $s_i$, i.e., $\left|\prod_{i \in \alpha} s_i\right|_{\mathbb{N}^\top} = \prod_{i \in \alpha} |s_i|_{\mathbb{N}^\top}$.

items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β), (s ×ˢ t).card = s.card * t.card
items.informal_description: For any finite sets $ s $ and $ t $, the cardinality of their Cartesian product $ s \times t $ is equal to the product of their cardinalities, i.e., $ |s \times t| = |s| \cdot |t| $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Dependent Product of Finite Sets Over a Finite Type
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (s : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)),
  (Fintype.piFinset s).card = ∏ i, (s i).card
items.informal_description: Given a finite type $\alpha$ and a family of finite sets $s(i)$ indexed by $\alpha$, the cardinality of the set of all functions $f : \alpha \to \bigcup_i \delta(i)$ satisfying $f(i) \in s(i)$ for every $i \in \alpha$ is equal to the product of the cardinalities of each $s(i)$. In symbols, $\#(\pi\text{Finset}\, s) = \prod_{i} \#(s(i))$.

items.type: ∀ (α : Type u_3) (β : Type u_4), Nat.card (α × β) = Nat.card α * Nat.card β
items.informal_description: For any types $\alpha$ and $\beta$, the cardinality of their Cartesian product $\alpha \times \beta$ is equal to the product of their cardinalities, i.e., $|\alpha \times \beta| = |\alpha| \cdot |\beta|$.

items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β}, (s ×ˢ t).ncard = s.ncard * t.ncard
items.informal_description: For any sets $s$ and $t$, the cardinality of their Cartesian product $s \times t$ is equal to the product of their individual cardinalities, i.e., $|s \times t| = |s| \cdot |t|$. This holds by definition of the natural number cardinality function, which returns zero for infinite sets.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Dependent Product over Finite Type
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (α i)],
  Fintype.card ((i : ι) → α i) = ∏ i, Fintype.card (α i)
items.informal_description: Given a finite type $\alpha$ with decidable equality and a family of finite types $\alpha(i)$ indexed by $\alpha$, the cardinality of the dependent product $\prod_{i \in \alpha} \alpha(i)$ is equal to the product of the cardinalities of each $\alpha(i)$, i.e., $\#\left( \prod_{i \in \alpha} \alpha(i) \right) = \prod_{i \in \alpha} \#\alpha(i)$.
